name: ibis Styles Kuala Lumpur Bukit Bintang
short_description: A design-economy hotel on Jalan Alor in the heart of Bukit Bintang, steps from the street's famous night-market food stalls.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Kuala Lumpur Bukit Bintang sits on Jalan Alor -- Kuala Lumpur's best-known street-food strip -- putting guests within walking distance of public transport and a dense mix of shopping, dining and nightlife. The hotel carries ibis Styles' colourful design-economy format, and the official ALL page shows a 4.3/5 customer rating from 506 reviews as of the research date.
